bullets: Six menus: League, Players, Insights, Tools, Minigames, NBA
Trends, Projections and Analytics live under Insights
Search sits on the right — or hit Ctrl + K
Biggest minutes swings vs season average
Owner column: free agent, or whose roster
Window: 7d / 15d / 30d, or any custom range

Minutes in every game this season

Dashed line = season average

bullets: Usage% line with minutes as bars
Role = minutes and usage moved together
Usage = same minutes, more of the offense
Catches breakouts before the box scores
Hot and cold streaks vs his own baseline
Baseline: last season, or prior two
“If it normalizes” = makes/game you'd lose
Season mode, or just the recent window
Every player ranked, best value first
8-cat z-scores over any date range
Slide the weights to match your build
Punt a category with one click

bullets: Projected stat line for the whole slate
